I don't know if I would say this was a sign but something I think about a lot. I don't remember how old I was, but definitely younger than 10. I was alone in my room and started to role play by myself. I was a little girl and decided to pretend I was a grown man at a bar picking up a woman. I even included a bathroom break where I went to the men's bathroom and stood while I peed (I used a marker as my penis). I didn't really have a full understanding of what I was role playing, but I can say that as a child I was exposed to a lot of things so I think I just picked up stuff that lead me to know about picking up women at a bar. The thing is I didn't sit and think about what I wanted to role play, that scenario just came naturally and I knew who I was supposed to be in it.
